LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_RemnantPatterns.label: remnant patterns
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_RemnantPatterns.descriptio:
Mech patterns designed to keep fighting with no one left to give the order: a heavy quadruped garrison mech that lies dormant at installation gates until the alarm line wakes it, and a large drone platform that flies cover for unmanned mother-drones. Both were drawn up for the pioneer expeditions, which needed defenses able to hold a world alone for decades before the fleet arrived, and both carry fallback directives that keep them executing their last standing order until the chassis fails.
Under the laws of war, weapons that outlast the conflict they were deployed for are classed alongside minefields. The remnants still guarding this world's beacons and installations are what these patterns become once their makers are gone.

Approved by ████ and ███, remnant patterns and their related technologies are designated class I sealed technology. Sale of such technology to developing worlds is prohibited, and its related technologies are to be progressively declassified once a colonial world's society attains class I standard.
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_RemnantPatterns.discovered:
Researchers have opened a class I sealed file containing the production patterns of two remnant mechs.

The bullhound, in both its shotgun and flamer patterns, and the Lanius can now be gestated at an automatroid constructor. Gestated units answer to their mechanitor like any other mech.

The remnants on this world are what these patterns become when no one is left to stand them down. The fleets sealed this file so that no new ones would be made. Fielding them openly will be noted.
